description: Golden fixture for Java 1.16 (M4 version expansion). Reference values are ALGORITHM-DERIVED by the pure-Dart DartWebBackend placement math driven by the Java 1.16 VersionStrategy (legacy pre-cave-and-cliffs ore distribution, region-grid salted structure placement, stronghold ring LCG walk, deterministic climate biomes). They are deterministic and self-consistent but NOT externally verified against Cubiomes/Chunkbase; the 1.16 placement tables (especially the legacy ore Y ranges/counts and the pre-1.18 biome layering) still need an authoritative native cross-check before the registry isVerified flag is flipped.
